name: Wingu / Djibouti Data Center (DDC)
developer: Wingu Africa / Djibouti Data Centre SARL
notes: Wingu's official Djibouti market page (checked 2026-08-12) presents the Djibouti Data Centre as the country's primary carrier-neutral colocation and connectivity hub with access to AMS-IX Djibouti/DjIX and major subsea cable systems; DCD history records the facility opened 2013 near Djibouti Telecom's cable landing infrastructure. Directory ~1 MW capacity is C-grade only, so capacity kept null. No AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle public cloud region in Djibouti per official provider pages (cloud-region exclusion re-checked 2026-08-12).

name: Wingu TO7 Technology Park data centre + carrier-neutral CLS (DJI02)
notes: Presidency of Djibouti (presidence.dj, 2024-11-25) and Wingu official page confirm the TO7 Technology Park on the site of the former Djibouti abattoir was inaugurated by President Guelleh in November 2024; DCD (2024-11-28) reports launch of the carrier-neutral data center and first carrier-neutral CLS plus innovation center. 'Tier 3/Tier III' is operator/trade wording with no Uptime record found; design capacity ~3 MW per methodology (directory 5 MW/5,000 kW figures are C-grade), so capacity_mw kept null with announced/design ~3 MW.

name: Djibouti Telecom Ras Dika cable landing station colocation center
notes: Djibouti Telecom built a three-floor cable landing station in Djibouti City (construction began 2021); the third floor was reserved for colocation to host cloud providers closer to African users, and Submarine Networks reports the Ras Dika CLS fully operational on 2023-08-07. A Djibouti Telecom official's LinkedIn post states the operator runs two data centers and three CLS (YAC A, Haramous, Ras Dika). Counted as telecom colocation facility because sources name colocation/hosting function; cable landing alone would not be a DC record.

name: PAIX JIB1 / PAIX Djibouti
developer: PAIX Data Centres and Djibouti Sovereign Fund (FSD)
notes: PAIX announced (2024-05-15) a JV with the Djibouti Sovereign Fund for a ~50,000 sq ft cloud- and carrier-neutral data center in Djibouti City; announced capacity up to 5 MW (announced_capacity_mw: 5.0) with first phase targeted 2026. Re-checked 2026-08-12: no construction/commissioning or permit evidence found, so status kept at planned/announced per DJ methodology; directory address 'Rue de Geneve' is C-grade only.
